name: figma-designer
description: Design in Figma through the Figma MCP: real variables, text styles, auto layout and components on a fixed visual system.

interface.shortDescription: Design in Figma with real tokens and components
interface.longDescription: Design screens, components and design systems inside Figma through the Figma MCP, with real variable collections, text styles, auto layout and a fixed visual system (Tailwind type and radius scale, spacing tokens, two-layer colour tokens, button and state rules). Requires the Figma MCP and the official Figma skills that this skill builds on.
defaultPrompt: Design this page in Figma with real variables and text styles.
Turn this mockup into Figma components in the project's design system.
Review this Figma file against a consistent token system.
